p.id,p.tenant_id AS tenantId,p.refund_id AS refundId,p.provider,p.external_refund_no AS externalRefundNo,p.amount_fen AS amountFen,p.status,p.verification_method AS verificationMethod,p.evidence_ref AS evidenceRef,p.voucher_file_id AS voucherFileId,p.succeeded_at AS succeededAt,p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt,p.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_refund r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.refund_no=#{refundNo}
SELECT FROM crm_refund r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_refund r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_refund r JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.customer_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id}

SELECT FROM crm_refund r JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.customer_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.order_id=#{orderId} AND r.customer_id=#{customerId} AND r.status=#{status} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_refund r JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.customer_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.order_id=#{orderId} AND r.customer_id=#{customerId} AND r.status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_refund SET status=#{toStatus},approved_fen=COALESCE(#{approvedFen},approved_fen),succeeded_fen=COALESCE(#{succeededFen},succeeded_fen),approved_by=COALESCE(#{approvedBy},approved_by),executed_by=COALESCE(#{executedBy},executed_by),succeeded_at=COALESCE(#{succeededAt},succeeded_at),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id AS tenantId,refund_id AS refundId,entitlement_id AS entitlementId,revoke_count AS revokeCount,allocated_fen AS allocatedFen FROM crm_refund_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND refund_id=#{refundId} ORDER BY entitlement_id
SELECT FROM crm_refund_payment p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.provider=#{provider} AND p.external_refund_no=#{externalRefundNo}
SELECT FROM crm_refund_payment p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_refund_payment p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.refund_id=#{refundId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT FROM crm_refund_payment p JOIN crm_refund r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.id=p.refund_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.order_id=#{orderId} AND p.status='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_refund_payment SET status=#{toStatus},succeeded_at=#{succeededAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id AS tenantId,refund_id AS refundId,from_status AS fromStatus,to_status AS toStatus,actor_user_id AS actorUserId,reason,created_at AS createdAt FROM crm_refund_status_history WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND refund_id=#{refundId} ORDER BY id
